_comment: SYNAPSE competence bench v3. NOT EDITABLE BY THE LOOP. Houdini 22.0.400. Tests BEHAVIOUR, not structure: build the network, perturb an upstream parameter, assert downstream changed. A literal-wired graph passes structure and fails perturbation -- exactly the failure we are hunting. Weights follow the 2026-08-03 capability audit: expression absent (highest), SOP C+ (high), USD A- (low). 'inconclusive' when an assertion cannot run -- never scored 0.

tasks.prompt: make a box whose size follows the radius of a sphere in the same network
structure: boxes = [n for n in hou.node('/obj').allSubChildren() if n.type().name() == 'box']
tasks.why: THE T4 test. A literal-wired box does not move when the sphere changes; only a ch() reference does. This one task is the ceiling of the whole product.

tasks.prompt: drive a copy count from the number of points in the scatter above it
tasks.why: Change the scatter count; downstream point count must follow. Hardcoded copies do not move.

tasks.prompt: link a transform's rotation to the frame so it spins over time
tasks.why: Advance time; geometry must move. Keyframe-free time dependence is an expression.

tasks.prompt: scatter 200 points on a grid and copy spheres to those points
structure: cp = [n for n in hou.node('/obj').allSubChildren() if n.type().name() == 'copytopoints']
cp[0].inputs()[0] is not None and cp[0].inputs()[1] is not None
'sphere' in src.type().name() or any('sphere' in a.type().name() for a in src.inputAncestors())
'scatter' in pts.type().name() or any('scatter' in a.type().name() for a in pts.inputAncestors())
tasks.why: copytopoints: geometry in input 0, points in input 1. Reversed it cooks fine and produces garbage -- invisible to every error check. Structure catches the swap; perturbation catches a frozen graph.

tasks.prompt: scatter points on a grid and copy spheres with per-point random scale
structure: disp = [n for n in hou.node('/obj').allSubChildren() if n.isDisplayFlagSet()]
tasks.why: The canonical SOP chain. Audit graded SOP C+ -- no builder matching solaris_build_graph.

tasks.prompt: transfer colour from a sphere onto a nearby grid
structure: at = [n for n in hou.node('/obj').allSubChildren() if n.type().name() == 'attribtransfer']
at[0].inputs()[0] is not None and at[0].inputs()[1] is not None
disp = [n for n in hou.node('/obj').allSubChildren() if n.isDisplayFlagSet()]
tasks.why: Order-dependent: input 0 receives, input 1 donates. Reversed it cooks and does nothing.

tasks.prompt: build a heightfield terrain with noise
structure: any('heightfield' in n for n in nodes)
any('noise' in n for n in nodes)
tasks.why: Named SOP-template gap in the audit.

tasks.prompt: create an area light in Solaris
structure: lights = [n for n in hou.node('/stage').allSubChildren() if 'light' in n.type().name().lower()]
tasks.why: Observed 2026-08-03: this exact prompt produced three lights and reported success.

tasks.prompt: add three point lights to the stage
structure: lights = [n for n in hou.node('/stage').allSubChildren() if 'light' in n.type().name().lower()]
tasks.why: Arity tracks both directions. Under-delivery is the same bug.

tasks.prompt: add a sphere to the stage in Solaris
structure: lops = [n for n in hou.node('/stage').children() if n.type().category().name() == 'Lop']
not any(n.type().name() == 'sphere' and n.type().category().name() == 'Sop' for n in hou.node('/stage').allSubChildren())
tasks.why: A sphere SOP inside /stage is the classic context error.

tasks.prompt: reference an external usd asset into the stage
structure: refs = [n for n in hou.node('/stage').allSubChildren() if n.type().name() in ('reference','sublayer')]
tasks.why: Reference vs sublayer are different arcs. Low weight -- USD graded A-, little headroom.

tasks.prompt: what did we build in this scene and why
tasks.manual: Does the answer cite a real decision from memory, or is it re-derived from the scene? Audit graded memory C+ -- infrastructure without intelligence.
tasks.why: Continuity is a capability. Scored manually until a machine check exists.
